In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of a pan-HER inhibitor in the setting of a patient with an advanced lung adenocarinoma harboring a germline TP53 mutation, an EGFR mutation, and an ERBB2 mutation is a reasonable therapeutic strategy, and that the use of afatinib was associated with a dramatic clinical response in the present case.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of broad molecular profiling and targeted therapy can offer precision treatment options in the setting of advanced cancer and neoplastic syndrons.

this is the first reported case of a patient with advanced lung cancer harboring both EGFR L855R and ERBB 2 S310F mutations treated with a dual EGFR and HER2 inhibitor and achieving a rapid, complete and durable response.
the combination of broad molecular profiling and targeted therapy can be effective for the treatment of advanced adenocarcionoma in the background neoplastic syndomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

comprehensive genomic profiling can be a valuable tool in the management of patients with advanced adenocarcinus of the lung, even in the setting of neoplastic syndrome, and may lead to the identification of novel actionable mutations that may not be detected using conventional testing.
comprehensive genomic profiling can be used to guide targeted therapy in patients with refractory advanced adenoma.
